description: Korean Air SKYPASS miles (flight distance x booking class percentage, from Korean Air's current international fare table: Q and T 70%, V 110%, D, I, R and C 125%, J 135%, F 200%, other classes 100%) and flight points (1 per flight within Korea, 2 per international flight) for one or more Korean Air flights, with progress toward Morning Calm, Morning Calm Select, Morning Calm Premium and Million Miler. Flights within Korea earn flight points only here (the domestic mileage table is not covered). Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and the ISO country codes of its two airports. Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

cls.description: Booking class. F = F (First Class, 200%); J = J (Prestige Flex, 135%); C = C (Prestige Plus, 125%); D = D (Prestige Standard, 125%); I = I (Prestige Standard, 125%); R = R (Prestige Standard, 125%); V = V (Premium Standard, Flex, 110%); W = W (Premium Standard, Flex, 100%); Y = Y (Economy Flex, 100%); B = B (Economy Flex, 100%); M = M (Economy Flex, 100%); S = S (Economy Standard, 100%); H = H (Economy Standard, 100%); E = E (Economy Standard, 100%); K = K (Economy Standard, 100%); L = L (Economy Saver, Standard, 100%); U = U (Economy Saver, Standard, 100%); Q = Q (Economy Saver, Standard, 70%); T = T (Economy Saver, Standard, 70%). The letter on your ticket. L, U, Q and T are sold as both Saver and Standard and earn the same either way.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter for creditTo, when it differs from the class question. Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Korean Air's own: alaska = Atmos Rewards (creditStatus one of: Atmos Rewards member, Atmos Silver, Atmos Gold, Atmos Platinum, Atmos Titanium); delta = Delta SkyMiles (creditStatus one of: SkyMiles Member, Silver Medallion, Gold Medallion, Platinum Medallion, Diamond Medallion); flying-club = Flying Club (creditStatus one of: Red, Silver, Gold); flying-blue = Flying Blue (creditStatus one of: Explorer, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ultimate). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. The booking class is cls (or creditClass). The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights.

life.description: Lifetime Korean Air miles so far (optional). Miles flown on Korean Air and SkyTeam airlines since you joined. Used only for the progress toward Morning Calm Premium and Million Miler. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

mi.description: Miles toward status so far (optional). Miles counted toward Morning Calm or Morning Calm Select in your current period. Used only for the progress. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

pts.description: Flight points so far (optional). 1 point per Korean Air flight within Korea, 2 per international flight. Used only for the progress. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

status.description: Your SKYPASS tier. SK = SKYPASS Club; MC = Morning Calm; MS = Morning Calm Select; MP = Morning Calm Premium (Lifetime); MM = Million Miler (Lifetime).

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way.
